description: Wallet PnL Timeseries. Calls only GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/pnl-ts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching wallet PnL timeseries data. Returns realized PnL by day, week or month for tracking wallet performance over time.

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/pnl-ts.

resolution.description: Time bucket size for each data point. Possible values: '1d' (daily), '1w' (weekly), '1mo' (monthly). Defaults to '1d'.

timeEnd.description: End of the time range (unix timestamp, seconds). Defaults to the end of the latest complete period.

timeStart.description: Start of the time range (unix timestamp, seconds). Defaults to the earliest complete period for the chosen resolution: 30 days ago for '1d', 12 weeks ago for '1w', or 12 months ago for '1mo'.

name: get-wallet-pnl-history
title: Wallet PnL Timeseries
